activity.notes: ATLAS uses c.27 BCE as a bounded Augustan-era intellectual and engineering milestone for Vitruvius. De architectura is generally dated to the Augustan context and was probably devised sometime after 27 BCE; the year is therefore explicitly approximate rather than a claimed publication date.

sources.title: Who was Vitruvius? — King's Visualisation Lab, King's College London
sources.citation_text: King's College London describes Vitruvius as a first-century BCE Roman architect, engineer and author and explains that De architectura was probably devised sometime after 27 BCE in the Augustan context.
